roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.lede: Dates are never quietly changed. When a date moves, the old one stays visible with the reason.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.summary: All sixteen departments go live over three weeks, following the life of an order.

phases.name: Monitoring
phases.summary: FabricXai on site daily, fixing issues the same day.

phases.name: Handover
phases.summary: Signed over to the factory owner.

phases.name: Maintenance
phases.summary: Bug fixes and support. No new features.

milestones.title: Merchandising study
milestones.what: Baraka's real merchandising documents studied to learn how the factory actually works.

milestones.title: Platform ready
milestones.what: Backend built; factory process map of sixteen departments and twenty-three hand-offs; screens designed.

milestones.title: Champion training
milestones.what: The IT officer, Baraka's system champion, is trained on every week-one module before anyone else. Saturday, 2 to 3 hours.

milestones.title: Kickoff, then the order front-end
milestones.what: Merchandising, sampling, procurement, commercial, IE and CAD go live so information flows across an order from day one.

milestones.title: The floor loop
milestones.what: Planning, sewing, store, cutting and fabric QC. Ten-line live board; supervisors enter hourly output on phones.

milestones.title: Finishing to money
milestones.what: Finishing, quality, shipment, accounts and the owner's daily view. All departments live.

milestones.title: Monitoring on the floor
milestones.what: Daily presence, same-day fixes, weekly review with management.

milestones.title: Handover to the owner
milestones.what: Walkthrough, accounts confirmed, training records, sign-off that every department is live.

milestones.title: Maintenance
milestones.what: Bug fixes, user questions, small adjustments. Support ends 31 January 2027 unless extended.

departments.title: Departments
departments.lede: A department is "live" when its people are trained, its current work is loaded, and it has entered data for five working days in a row.

tiles.name: System champion (IT officer)
tiles.info: Saturday 20 Sep, 2 to 3 hours, all week-one modules

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.title: the floor loop, 28 September to 2 October

log.title: Progress log
log.lede: Written by FabricXai every working day during implementation, weekly during monitoring. Plain words, including what went wrong.

entries.title: Roadmap shared, champion named, this portal opened
entries.body: The implementation roadmap was sent to Baraka management. Baraka's IT officer will be the system champion and is trained first, on Saturday 20 September. Week-one sessions are set for Sunday, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. This portal goes live so both teams look at the same page from now on.

entries.title: Every department's screens designed
entries.body: Screen designs completed for all sixteen departments following one set of layout rules, so a person who learns one department's screens can read every other department's. Floor screens designed for phones in Bangla.

entries.title: Factory process map finished
entries.body: How an order moves through Baraka from enquiry to payment, written down department by department: sixteen departments, twenty-three hand-offs between them. Merchandising reviewed the merchandising part.

entries.title: Merchandising study started
entries.body: Sat with the merchandising team and collected the documents they work with every day. This is what the system is being shaped around.

issues.title: Issues
issues.lede: Anyone at Baraka can raise one from any screen of the app. Every issue is acknowledged the same working day and stays here until it is fixed or we explain why not.
issues.empty: No issues raised yet. The first one will appear here with who raised it, which department, and when it was acknowledged.

data.title: Data we hold
data.lede: Every document or dataset Baraka has given FabricXai, what it is used for, and who can see it.

rows.item: Buyer enquiry packs (design sheet, spec, lay plan)
rows.usedFor: Enquiry screen; teaching Marbim to read incoming packs

rows.item: Buyer purchase orders with size breakdown
Supplier proforma invoices and cloth orders

assurances.title: Where it is stored
assurances.body: Encrypted storage in the Baraka environment at baraka.fabricxai.com. Not mixed with any other factory's data.

assurances.title: Who owns it
assurances.body: Baraka. FabricXai uses it only to build and support this system and deletes working copies at handover.

assurances.title: Nothing is public
assurances.body: No document, buyer, price or quantity from Baraka appears anywhere outside this portal and the app.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.lede: The weekly 30-minute review with management, written up the same day. The champion marks each one as acknowledged.

handover.title: Handover and support
handover.lede: What has to be true on 29 October for the system to be signed over, and what support looks like after that.

checklist.item: System champion named: the IT officer
Every department live for five working days
All user accounts and permissions confirmed by department heads
Training record complete: who, what, when, quick cards handed out
Open issues either fixed or accepted into maintenance
Owner walkthrough of the owner view and this portal

maintenance.title: Maintenance, 1 November to 31 January 2027
included: Small changes to existing screens and reports
notIncluded: Changes to how a department works
maintenance.until: Issues are raised through the system champion and acknowledged the same working day. Support ends

agreement.title: Working agreement
agreement.lede: What each team owes the other. One page, agreed at kickoff.

sides.title: FabricXai will
items: Update this portal every working day during implementation and weekly after
Acknowledge every issue the same working day and give a fix date
Tell Baraka about any slipped date here, with the reason, before Baraka notices
Be on the floor the morning after each department goes live
Never show Baraka's data outside this portal and the app

sides.title: Baraka will
items: Keep the IT officer as system champion and single point of contact
Make the agreed people available for their training hour in their week
Have each live department enter its data daily, not at week end
Raise problems in the app or portal, not only by phone
Attend the 30-minute weekly review

escalation.label: If something is stuck:
escalation.rule: No step should take more than one working day.
